$comment: The copy deck of Build Specification v2, section 13. Every visitor-facing
string in the Simulator is read from this file.
The author writes every 'text' value. The developer wires slots and never
writes or edits prose, which is why every text below ships empty: an empty
slot is a slot still waiting for the author, and the build says so rather
than inventing a sentence to fill it.
'budget' is the proposed character budget for that slot, to be agreed with
the designer. 'where' says where the slot appears, so the author can write
Three rules apply to every slot and are enforced by sim/tests/copy.test.js:
no sentence may tell the reader to buy, sell, switch, hold, redeem, stop,
start or continue an investment; nothing may reference a moment (no dates,
no index levels, no fund names, no rate presented as current), so the copy
never ages; and the words 'insider' and 'veteran' must not appear.

chapterRefs.$comment: Book pointers resolve through this table so chapter numbering stays under the author's control. Fill each value with the chapter reference as it should read.

POS-INTRO.where: Module A, above the transaction table: what this reading will tell them.

POS-TOO-EARLY.where: State S-EARLY. Totals are shown; every annualised reading is suppressed.

POS-STALE.where: State S-STALE. A banner above the report. The date is substituted by the app.

POS-VALUE-APPROX.where: Beside an estimated value: what the estimate excludes.

POS-UNITS-NEGATIVE.where: Stop condition: the entries and the fund do not reconcile.

POS-ROW-BEFORE-FUND.where: Stop condition: a row is dated before the fund's first NAV.

POS-ROW-NO-NAV.where: Beside a row with no NAV within seven days of its date.

POS-STRETCH-LOW.where: State S-STRETCH-LOW. Percentile at or below the low threshold.

POS-STRETCH-HIGH.where: State S-STRETCH-HIGH. Percentile at or above the high threshold.

POS-STRETCH-NA.where: State S-STRETCH-NA. Not enough record to place the stretch in.

POS-ALT-BEHIND.where: State S-ALT-BEHIND. Against the replay in the proxy fund.

POS-ALT-NONE.where: State S-ALT-NONE. No proxy, or the proxy does not cover the span.

POS-REPLAY-LINE.where: The one-sentence replay pattern; the proxy fund name is substituted.

POS-NEXT-STALE-RECORD.where: Next-step label for S-STALE. Opens Module B at the full range.

POS-NEXT-GAP-TIMING.where: Next-step label for the gap states. Carries [CH-REF:INSTALMENT-TIMING].

POS-NEXT-EVERY-STRETCH.where: Next-step label for the stretch states. Opens Module B at the visitor's span.

POS-NEXT-FULL-RECORD.where: Next-step label for S-STRETCH-NA. Opens Module B at the full range.

POS-NEXT-OVERLAY.where: Next-step label for the alternative states. Opens Module B with the overlay on.

RR-MEANING-1Y.where: The interpretation panel for the 1-year window.

RR-MEANING-3Y.where: The interpretation panel for the 3-year window.

RR-MEANING-5Y.where: The interpretation panel for the 5-year window.

RR-MEANING-7Y.where: The interpretation panel for the 7-year window.

RR-MEANING-10Y.where: The interpretation panel for the 10-year window.

RR-MEANING-OVERLAY.where: The interpretation panel addition when a benchmark overlay is drawn.

RR-NO-PROXY.where: No index-fund proxy exists for this category.

RR-PROXY-LABEL.where: The transparency label under the overlay: what the proxy is and is not.

RR-PROXY-SHORT.where: The proxy is younger than the range being shown.

RR-IDCW-ROUTE.where: Why an IDCW selection was routed to its Growth twin.

RR-STALE.where: The scheme has stopped publishing NAV. The date is substituted.

RR-NO-HISTORY.where: No provider has any NAV history for the selected scheme. Distinct from every provider being unreachable, which is ERR-DATA-DOWN.

RR-TOO-YOUNG.where: The fund is younger than the window. The two figures are substituted.

RR-FEW-WINDOWS.where: Fewer than the minimum windows; the count is printed prominently.

XIRR-MEANING.where: The interpretation panel under the XIRR result.

XIRR-SUB-YEAR.where: Span under a year: why an annualised rate misleads over a short span.

XIRR-NEED-VALUE.where: Validation 2: not exactly one Value today row.

XIRR-SAME-SIGN.where: Validation 4: every flow points the same way.

XIRR-NO-SOLVE.where: Solver 9.3: no single yearly rate settles these entries.

XIRR-COMPARE-STEADY.where: The 'compare against a steady rate' comparator. Ships with no rate filled.

LANDING-PROMISE.where: The home screen promise, under the product name.

ERR-DATA-DOWN.where: Every provider is unreachable; cached data is being shown.
